name: Caladan
tagline: The Water World, Ancestral Home of House Atreides

landmarks.name: Castel Caladan
landmarks.subtitle: Ancient Seat of House Atreides
landmarks.summary: An ancient, stone-hewn fortress overlooking the sea, serving as the home of the Atreides for generations.
landmarks.lore: Carved into the coastal cliffs, Castel Caladan is heavily fortified against both naval and aerial assault, yet maintains a deep harmony with the surrounding natural ecosystem.

gallery.caption: Storm clouds gathering over the coastal cliffs

landmarks.name: Eastern Pundi Rice Terraces
landmarks.subtitle: Agricultural Hub
landmarks.summary: Extensive submerged farming terraces responsible for the majority of the planet's Pundi rice output.
landmarks.lore: The local fishing and farming communities have cultivated these tidal regions for centuries, creating a sustainable foundation for the planet's economy.

gallery.caption: Workers harvesting in the flooded terraces
